build: Modwerk's linker: the released core-ar2 0.3 (6b97dfb3…3e58) + this folder's compiled Pad Select 0.4.0-experimental, materialised against the owner's stock OS 1.74, --version PS05
conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the missing-calibration notices; GLOBAL, six DOWNs and YES open CONTROL; two DOWNs and YES open SEQUENCER CONFIG; three DOWNs move to PAD+TRIG SEL TRK and YES checks it; four NOs leave the menus; pad SD is pressed (silent: the play routine returns before the trigger, no MIDI out), then FUNC + SD (plays, MIDI note velocity 127). Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified. The same frames came out of a run resumed from a snapshot of this boot. The earlier builds PS74 (0.2.0), PS03 and PS04 (0.3.0) gave the same four frames byte for byte.
